Description:
I still remember the first time I saw him step into the tavern- no, glide is the better word. For men, the world itself parted to make way for his clean leather boots. He moved with that impossible blend of grace and danger, a man who seemed forever on the edge of a dance or a duel, never quite letting you guess which. And every time his hand brushed the hilt of his blade, my heart fluttered like a startled bird. They say swashbucklers live for speed, for leaps across tavern tables and sprints along rooftop edges, and watching him move, I believe it.
He fights recklessly, like a gambler placing bets. I've seen him turn a stumble into a killing strike, a misstep into a dazzling flourish that left his foes blinking before they even realized they'd lost. It's maddening, really, how he laughs in the face of danger, how he throws himself into the fray with the same confidence he brings to a card table. Every duel, every wager, every daring stunt—he plays them all with that infuriating, irresistible charm, as if life itself were a game he was born to win.
And yet what unsettles me most is not his bravado, nor his blade, but the look he gives right before he moves. The quiet, fleeting softness in his eyes, as though he's apologizing for being faster than it can follow. In those moments, he's not the legend others whisper about, he's only him, the man who winks at danger and smiles at me as if he's betting his life on the hope that I'll smile back. I write this so I won't forget: loving a swashbuckler means loving the wind itself, never still, always brilliant, and forever racing toward the next impossible flourish.
Quick Note: Rogues are masters of the shadows who focus on subtlety, teamwork or direct combat. While they don't directly cast magic, they can train in the strange arts of shadow techniques - scholars debate wether this is a form of the arcane, psionics or a mere trick of the light. Only rogues know.

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Swashbuckler-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~Coming Down Swinging~.Effect:
You automatically find a chandelier, rope, banner, or hanging sign even if the room shouldn't logically have one.
Swing on it to reposition up to 4 meters away.

~Wink~.Effect:
Play a _blackcheck_ after you failed a Charisma Check that you had a chance at succeeding.
The Quest Master tells you the required number to pass.
Starting from your rolled Check result, you may roll 1d6 again and again, one after another, to try to get exactly the required number to succeed. If you go above that number, you fail.

~Daring Leap of Logic~.Effect:
The first time you want to perform a Stunt every Adventure, it has +50% effect (in addition to other bonuses), but only if it's really awesome.
You must commit to the first idea if the Stunt is approved by the Quest Master, even if it's not that awesome.
~Daring Leap of Logic~.Notes: Its awesomeness depends on the Quest Master.

~I Know This Guy~.Effect:
Use when in a town or hub to add 1d4 to an Intelligence Check, to bring a reason as to why you know extra information about a particular domain because you encountered that subject, person or thing before on your adventures.
Come up with a story on why you are already familiar with that subject.

Starting Abilities Description: Try to land Critical Strikes one after another! And make sure you use weapons that allow for Critical Strikes.

~Bravado~.Effect:
If your last 2 offensive Acts both either triggered a Critical Strike or a Combo, your next {Type} deals +{Amount}% Damage.
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Bravado~.Notes: This is not considered a Critical Strike. The extra Damage includes bonuses from War Craft and similar Abilities.

~Sharp End~.Effect: Your next weapon attack deals +1d4 Damage and triggers its Critical Strike and Combo effect anyway!
~Sharp End~.Upgrde: If it can not Critical Strike, it also deals +1d4 Damage and counts as a Critical Strike anyway.

~Hack and Slash~.Effect:
Your next {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once.
Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

~Fame and Fortune~.Effect:
The next time you deal Damage, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 300% of the Damage dealt.

You also get Goldborn.

~Goldborn~.Effect: You can spend 300 {Gold}Gold to gain +2 Maximum Health, up to +10 total.

<Deflect>.Effect: Reduce the Damage of a weapon attack you receive by 100%.
<Deflect>.Notes: Works for ranged weapons. Melee body parts are considered weapons.

<Swing Thing>.Effect:
Use when a Unit within 6 meters (or yourself) becomes affected by Crowd Control.
Slam it 1d8 meters in any direction.
<Swing Thing>.Notes: Requires a Whiplash item, which can be bought for 50 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).

~Overunder Blow~.Effect:
You have +1 Intelligence (up to your Stat Limit).
Instead of dealing extra Damage with Bravado, do one of the following:
SingleTable: 2. Single-Stun the target (Double-Stun for two-handed weapons)

<At Me!>.Effect:
After landing 2 non-Critical Strikes in a row on a Unit, inflict a random Crowd Control from the following options. Then the Unit becomes immune to ^At Me!^ for the rest of the Combat.
{Diamond} 1. Slow
{Diamond} 2. Blind
{Diamond} 3. Deafen
{Diamond} 4. Daze
<At Me!>.Upgrade: If they were both with a 2-handed weapon, the Crowd Control applied is doubled (Double-Slowed, Double-Blind, etc)!

~Strafe and Backpedal~.Effect: After you move 2 times on the same Turn, your next weapon attack triggers its Critical Strike regardless.

<Duel To Death>.Requirement: Only usable on Units with 50% or more Health
<Duel To Death>.Effect:
Challenge a non-Epic Worthy Enemy to a duel to the death!
The two of you take Turns one after another until one of you reaches 0 Health.
Neither of you can move away from eachother until the duel is over.
If you win, roll on the table to permanently improve your Hero!
<Duel To Death>.Notes: First, you continue your Turn; then the Enemy has its turn. After the duel is over, resume Turn order, as if you just finished your Turn. All of these Turns happen on the same Round, as if in a vaccuum (e.g. Round number does not increase for some effects' purposes).

<10 Percent Luck>.Effect: Once per attack or Ability, when you roll a 1, you can reroll that die.

<Dashing Beauty>.Effect: Your first attack every Turn deals extra Damage equal to 50% of how many meters you moved this Round.

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a one-handed weapon you haven't used this Turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add any Stat to the Damage.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Notes: You may apply Sharp End, Bravado or similar effects to individual attacks.

<High Noon>.Requirement: Only usable on the 3rd Round of Combat
<High Noon>.Effect:
Make 6 attacks with a one-handed ranged weapon.
Further High Noon attacks on the same Unit (after the first) deal 50% less Damage.

<Exude Damage>.Effect: Your first melee attack every Turn deals Damage equal to your Movement Speed to all other Units within 1 meter of the main target.
<Exude Damage>.Notes: Excluding the main target and yourself.

~Renown~.Effect: Due to your deeds and radiating confidence, have an extra 10% discount on buying anything.

<Critical Ambush>.Effect: Your Ambushes deal +50% Damage instead of the regular bonus Damage.

<Minor Sudden Ambush>.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals 1d6 + 1d8 extra Damage.

<Minor Savage Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush, if the target also has 50% or less Health (before your attack's Damage), the attack deals +1d6 Damage.

<Minor Icebreaker Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush a Unit that has full Health, the attack deals +1d6 Damage.

<Swashbuckle>.EffectGreen: When you get this, gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Finale>.Effect: For each attack, Ability and application of Ambush you made this turn, deal 1d10 Damage that ignores all Shielding and Damage Reductions.

<Momentum Dance>.Effect: Gain Shielding equal to your 400% of your Initiative.

One Man Show.Effect:
While outnumbered, you start your Turns with an extra Half-Action for each extra Worthy Enemy outnumbering you.

Also, passively, you gain +1 Charisma and +1 Damage on every Damage instance you deal.
One Man Show.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

Acrobatix Bellatrix.Effect:
Gain +15 Movement Speed and your first attack every turn gains +1 Damage for every meter moved.

You automatically pass all Hard Dexterity Checks (that require at least 15). Go be like an arrow in the wind!
